label: EVENT_LOGIC_V2_FREEZE
rationale: E2 adds scene priors (water_line_auto, board_cx filtering) which require calibrated scene geometry per pool. With COCO detector on development corpus (360p, uncontrolled backgrounds), E2 priors are unreliable. E1 is selected for robustness. E2 remains available for future pool-specific calibration.

key_innovations: Board re-contact detection prevents HURDLE motion from triggering false takeoff
Velocity-based preparation end detection (not position variance)
PTS-aware velocity: dt from actual timestamps, not 1/fps
Water contact via cy_norm threshold, not last frame / track dropout

known_limitations: COCO detector (yolov8n.pt) used as fallback — L1 domain-adapted weights produce 0 detections on Paris canary (domain mismatch, generalization failure). MPS and CPU both work for inference. 4.3% recall at 360p on development corpus. State machine validated on canary (1080p, 100% recall). Detection failure is corpus distribution mismatch, not inference hardware. Ref: PHASE_M_CANARY_CHECK_AUDIT.json, real-signal pipeline V1 report (2026-09-06).
Board re-contact heuristic requires non-positive velocity after hurdle guard; may fail if board loading is very brief or camera angle obscures trajectory.
Water contact via cy_norm threshold is pool/framing dependent; E2 water_line_auto mitigates this but is not selected for INTERNAL_EVAL.
DEVELOPMENT corpus evaluation blocked by detector scale failure; Phase I run with COCO fallback only.
_cuda_claim_status: REMOVED 2026-09-06. L1 weights confirmed to work on MPS+CPU. Detection failure is domain mismatch, not CUDA absence. Ref: PHASE_M_CANARY_CHECK_AUDIT.json, real-signal pipeline V1 report.
